[DAY2 21:22:31 - DAY2 21:23:00]
I say, "Let's do something outdoors tomorrow." I look toward Shure. Shure asks, "How about KTV?" "No way," I say, laughing, and I look at Katrina, smiling. Katrina says, "There's a park nearby, I think." I turn around. Katrina says, "It's two or three kilometers away. Do you want to go to the park?" I walk to the stairway entrance and say, "We can go shoot some scenery and take some pictures." I look at my friends as we discuss plans to screen the film on the last day — Katrina adds, "Screen the film on the last day." "Yeah, let's go capture some scenery," I say. Katrina asks, "So it's outdoor tomorrow, right?" "Yeah, outdoor tomorrow," I reply. I notice Shure still swaying, then I see Choiszt walk over.

[DAY2 21:33:30 - DAY2 21:34:00]
I'm listening to my friends chat. Lucia: "I think if a guy gets it," Tasha: "A choker?" Lucia: "it's not really..." Tasha: "Hahaha!" I smile at Tasha and look at Alice; he prepares to put on gloves. I say, "How about you guys go downstairs and discuss tomorrow's plans?" Tasha: "What's happening tomorrow?" I say, "Yeah — outdoor activities, an outdoor excursion; we're taking some photos." Tasha: "Outdoor?" Tasha: "What kind of excursion?" I look at Tasha. Tasha: "Like this?" I say, "Let's play around. Yeah." Lucia: "Like tourist photos?" I see Lucia make a small gesture. Tasha: "A picnic?" I add, "Uh, maybe on the last day we'll show some short clips or something."

[DAY2 21:35:30 - DAY2 21:35:59]
I continue chatting with Lucia and Tasha, gesturing with my right hand. "Actually, we don't need to... I just think maybe on the last day we can put up a background wall and put some photos on it," I say. Tasha replies, "That works too. I thought we were going to act out a drama." I add, "Yeah. Like those short films with a plot—if we have any, we can. Actually, for Earth Day we could just show some PPTs, show some movies or short films, and then tomorrow we could do some outdoor activities."
